title: refactor(ci): split lint/test/release workflows, optimize cache & parallelism, bump actions/deps
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: the current monolithic CI workflow is slow to iterate, caches are underutilized, and release automation has intermittent race conditions. This PR splits the single workflows/ci.yml into three focused pipelines (lint, test, release), standardizes cache keys across repositories, optimizes job parallelism for node/pytest matrices, and bumps GitHub Actions/third-party action versions to address known flakiness and security alerts. Changes include: structured lint pipeline with faster incremental checks, test workflow with smarter matrix and workspace cache, release workflow with improved mutexing and dry-run steps, a small helper script for cache key generation, and docs updates. Impact: shorter incremental CI runs for most PRs, more reliable release automation, and fewer spurious cache misses. See linked Linear tickets for rollout plan and opt-in toggles.
